items.title: Container logs on the VM are unbounded — no rotation on any service
items.summary:
Found while fixing #546 (the ai container logging no requests): adding request logs made me check where those logs *go*, and nothing bounds them.

## The gap

No service in `docker-compose.prod.yml` — `caddy`, `web`, `ai` or `db` — declares a `logging:` block. Docker's default is the `json-file` driver **with no `max-size` and no `max-file`**, so every container's stdout accumulates under `/var/lib/docker/containers/**/*-json.log` until the disk fills. Nothing rotates it, and nothing reclaims it
